summary: Returns the range once it is known to lie within another, or throws.
description: The assertion form of `isGridRangeContainedIn`. The default message names both ranges in A1 notation, which is what makes the failure readable in an execution log.

params.range2: The range it is compared against.
params.message: The message of the exception. A default naming both ranges is used when omitted.

throws.InvalidGridRangeException: the first range is not contained in the second.
